ALPHA GUIDE 
Page 33 of 76 
 
The Bible is the most… 
• Popular 
• Powerful 
• Precious (Psalm 19:10) 
• … book in the world. 
 
“Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of 
God.” (Matthew 4:4). 
 
 
1. BRINGING REVELATION – GOD HAS SPOKEN 
• Bible: collection of books by 40+ authors over 1600 years 
• Inspired: God-breathed 
 
“All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training 
in righteousness.” (2 Timothy 3:16) 
 
But what about difficulties in the Bible? 
• Jesus is the interpretive key  
• It’s authoritative (2 Timothy 3:16–17) 
• Practical wisdom: 
– Guidelines for living 
 
– Guidance for good decisions
